lighting_notes: Pale, melancholic gray sky transitioning into a blazing sunrise — this is a two-beat lighting change within one scene: start with low Directional Light intensity and a desaturated/cool Post Process grade, then raise intensity and warm the grade as the sun rises in the second beat. Good candidate for the companion Starter Course tutorial's dusk/dawn Directional Light repositioning technique (Ctrl+L).
action: A fresh, unmarked mound of dirt rests near the shore, completely isolated — Ananya's grave. Then: the sun rises high over the horizon, casting harsh light over the ocean and the grave.

narration.line: She rests now in her quiet tomb, submerged beneath an endless ocean called Time. The world moved on, and all forgot her name.
Only the Sun God above remains her eternal witness.

shot_list.description: EXT. BARREN COASTLINE - DAWN — the unmarked grave, isolated, pale gray sky, narration line 1
EXT. SKY - CONTINUOUS — the sun rising, harsh light over ocean and grave, narration line 2, then FADE OUT

continuity_notes: Closing scene, narrator V.O. only, no on-screen characters. Gives the episode's title ('The Ocean of Time') its visual payoff — make sure the ocean itself is prominent in frame, not just the grave mound. Ends the episode on FADE OUT.
